figmaHints:
/* ================================================================
       DS Badge Component — token-based styles dari tokens.css
       Figma source: appearance=default/primary/subtle/important/added/removed
       Semantic token mapping:
         Color-Background-Neutral       → --color-neutral-n20  (#F5F6F7)
         Color-Text-Bold                → --color-neutral-n900 (#091E42)
         Color-Background-Brand-Bold    → --color-blue-b300    (#1E7FD6)
         Color-Text-Inverse             → --color-neutral-n0   (#FFFFFF)
         Color-Elevation-Surface        → --color-neutral-n10  (#FAFBFB)
         Color-Text-Brand               → --color-blue-b300    (#1E7FD6)
         Color-Background-Danger-Bold   → --color-red-r300     (#EC1C24)
         Color-Background-Success       → --color-green-g50    (#E6F7EF)
         Color-Text-Success             → --color-green-g300   (#00AA5B)
         Color-Background-Danger-Inverse→ --color-red-r50      (#FDE8E9)
         Color-Text-Danger              → --color-red-r300     (#EC1C24)
    ================================================================ */

transition.raw:
transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94),
                  box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94),
                  border-color 160ms ease
transition.resolved:
transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94),
                  box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94),
                  border-color 160ms ease

transition.raw: opacity 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease, background-color 150ms ease
transition.resolved: opacity 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease, background-color 150ms ease
